newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to dip further, support at 113-14.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to dip further, support at 113-14.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will head towards support at 113-14 on Thursday, disappointed that the UK budget on Wednesday did not do enough to ease the pressure for higher interest rates, analysts said.
"It's definitely going to slip further at the open but not too much lower," Phillip Gardiner, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London said.
Gardiner said initial support at 113-14 came from an hourly low during trade on June 25.
Gilts slumped to a low of 113-30 in APT trade on Wednesday, after a pit close of 114-25.
